scripts.music: node scripts/make-music.mjs && remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i public/music.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k public/music.mp3
scripts.render: node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts ShipItLaunch out/shipit-launch.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.still: node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts ShipItLaunch
